name: multiframe-partner
description: Кабинет партнёра MultiFrame: общие команды проверки для apps/api и apps/web

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.check: npm run architecture:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
